answer_1.quote: Experiments show that E2LLM outperforms 8 baselines in long document summarization and QA using the same pretrained LLM and limited fine-tuning data.

answer_2.quote: For summarization, we use the geometric mean (G-mean) of Rouge metrics, which compare n-gram overlap between generated and reference texts. For QA, we calculate the F1 score based on unigram overlap between generated and reference answers. We also compute perplexity (PPL) of the correct answer across all datasets as a semantic-level metric to assess model prediction accuracy.
